source.description: The input line this row came from

feedUrl.description: The RSS feed the episode came from; null for a direct file URL

feedTitle.description: The show title from the feed

episodeTitle.description: The episode title from the feed

episodeGuid.description: The episode guid from the feed

episodeUrl.description: The episode web page from the feed

publishedAt.description: Publish date (ISO 8601); null when the feed date cannot be read

audioUrl.description: The audio file that was fetched

durationSeconds.description: Audio length measured on the downloaded file, not taken from the feed

language.description: Spoken language (ISO 639-1) as detected by the engine

transcriptSource.description: stt = transcribed from the audio; publisher = the feed's own transcript

engine.description: The speech-to-text model that produced most of the text, or publisher-vtt and similar

segments.description: Transcript segments: start and end in seconds from the start of the episode, text, speaker (null without speaker labels)

summary.description: Summary in the transcript's language; null when not asked for or not available

chapters.description: Chapters with start (seconds) and title, ascending

keyQuotes.description: Quotes with start (seconds) and text; each appears word for word in the transcript

wordCount.description: Number of words in the transcript

files.description: Links to the TXT, SRT, VTT and JSON files in the key-value store

billedMinutes.description: Audio minutes charged for this episode (rounded up); 0 when the publisher transcript was used

license.description: The podcast:license the feed states, if any

status.description: ok, error or skipped; error and skipped rows are not charged

errorCode.description: Stable reason code when status is error or skipped, for example feed_http_404, not_audio or episode_too_long

errorMessage.description: What went wrong, in plain words
